home.sec.pathNote.zh-CN: 五个阶段、68 课。先观察系统，再逐层深入到模型内部，最后回到全栈验收。
home.sec.pathNote.en: Five stages, 68 lessons: observe a running system, go layer by layer into the model, then return to full-stack verification.

home.sec.topicsNote.zh-CN: 已有基础时，可以从一个具体问题进入。每个主题保留基础与深入两种本地入口。
home.sec.topicsNote.en: With some background you can enter through a specific question. Each topic keeps both a basic and an in-depth entry point.

home.sec.furtherNote.zh-CN: 继续研究内部实现、综合案例与原始研究主题。
home.sec.furtherNote.en: Go on to internal implementations, worked cases and original research topics.

home.tool.visualNote.zh-CN: 逐步观察计算与状态变化
home.tool.visualNote.en: Watch the computation and state change step by step

home.tool.labsNote.zh-CN: 修改输入，核对中间结果
home.tool.labsNote.en: Change the input and check the intermediate results

home.tool.glossaryNote.en: Look up a definition and the lesson it belongs to

home.tool.workedNote.en: Find a complete worked example by question

home.tool.atlasNote.zh-CN: 基础课程 201 张节内图解

home.tool.coverageNote.en: 206 topic notes mapped to their prerequisites

home.row1.zh-CN: 先把一次任务的运行过程变成可检查的证据，再谈改动。
home.row1.en: First turn one task run into evidence you can inspect; only then change anything.

home.row2.zh-CN: 工具调用、上下文、检索、记忆与失败恢复，构成可控的执行循环。
home.row2.en: Tool calls, context, retrieval, memory and failure recovery make the loop controllable.

home.row3.zh-CN: 不打开模型，先用权限、固定任务和完整计时判断优化是否真的有效。
home.row3.en: Without opening the model, use permissions, a fixed task and end-to-end timing to judge whether an optimisation helped.

home.row4.zh-CN: 从服务接口走进张量、前向、训练、推理，直到 GPU 与调度。
home.row4.en: From the service interface into tensors, the forward pass, training and inference, down to the GPU and the scheduler.

home.row5.zh-CN: 把多模态、不确定性与跨层优化接回同一套验收标准。
home.row5.en: Bring multimodality, uncertainty and cross-layer optimisation back to one set of acceptance criteria.

home.note.expanded.en: Lesson text and figures are fully expanded.
